The originating Zulip thread shows the clarification came from confusion about email token search and relied on the already-existing Search page prose that string-backed token searches are not case sensitive. Related FHIR-40565 was separately resolved No Change, so it is background only.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current source/search.html token section still contains both the general string case-insensitivity sentence and the corrected table wording requested by FHIR-40569.
